name: LongFact
description: LongFact is a benchmark designed to measure the long-form factuality of large language models across 38 open-domain topics. It evaluates the accuracy of detailed, multi-fact responses using an automated evaluation method called SAFE, which leverages search-augmented reasoning to verify facts against web search results.
reputation: A newer factuality benchmark that has gained attention in LLM evaluation research, especially for long-form generation and search-augmented fact checking.
notes: Benchmark includes ~16k individual facts; uses an LLM-based automated evaluator (SAFE) that outperforms human annotators in cost and agreement.
